title: The Oath of the Weeping Wood Revisited
author: E. M. Villalobos
blurb: Orsen Kavanagh, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
